prediction_snapshot.verification_method: Repository PredictionSnapshot model_dump(mode=json), remove snapshot_hash, json.dumps ensure_ascii=False sort_keys=True separators=(comma,colon), SHA256
prediction_snapshot.integrity_note: Stored hash differs from canonical hash. This does not prove post-open mutation; preserve original and investigate creation/provenance. Scores are provisional.

realization.turnover_scope: TWSE total securities including odd-lot/block/after-hours statistics; not regular-session-only turnover

quantitative_evaluation.breadth_definition: sign of listed-stock advancing minus declining counts
quantitative_evaluation.regime_note: Daily OHLC shows close at the high after a dip below prior close. Time-resolved path unavailable; do not infer a full-day regime from OHLC alone.
quantitative_evaluation.limitations: Integrity mismatch blocks admission to trusted benchmark; no frozen baseline and insufficient sample for calibration.

market_view.note: Positive close occurred, but index strength did not extend to positive stock breadth.

open_hypothesis.note: Opened 21.85 points above prior close, only 4.56bp: economically flat under configured 5bp threshold, versus expected +55bp.

intraday_hypothesis.note: Low crossed below prior close and close equaled high above 48000. Range/resistance narrative did not describe terminal strength; exact path and VWAP unavailable.

close_hypothesis.note: Close up 86.22bp versus expected +45bp. Non-electronics breadth proxy fell, so the conditional driver explanation remains incomplete.

bull_script.note: Bull numeric threshold realized; electronics/semiconductors positive and close above 48000. Broad participation/VWAP conditions not established.

base_script.note: Small positive raw gap occurred, but closing magnitude exceeded base threshold and breadth was negative.

bear_script.note: Close stayed above prior close; negative breadth alone did not realize bear outcome.

key_drivers.note: Official cross-section supports electronic leadership and financial/non-electronic drag. Micron causal impact, overnight observations and US yield claims were not independently verified in this run.

invalidation_conditions.note: Gap stayed within stated limits; 48000 held at close, but expanding breadth condition failed. 09:15-09:30 VWAP/sector breadth and memory response require intraday data.

actual_driver_attribution: Official sector returns indicate electronics/semiconductors led the positive index while financials and non-electronics detracted; causal catalyst attribution not proven.

proposed_model_changes.proposal: Enforce canonical snapshot hash verification before committing morning snapshot; preserve failed originals and record separate provenance audit.
Separate raw open sign from configured 5bp direction class and calibrate gap magnitude.
Model listed-stock breadth separately from electronic heavyweight returns; require current breadth confirmation rather than carry yesterday breadth forward.

model_change_gate.reason: Single-day evidence and failed integrity gate; investigate pipeline before model tuning.
